title: EchoNomics
tagline: Decentralized streaming where creators launch tokens, fans trade their futures, and tip in crypto
description:
This project allows streamers for getting tips, and the users an opportunity to trade futures on their favorite streamers. Built using Hardhat v3, and deployed on Base sepolia, and adding cross chain functionalities using Avail nexus. 
If you are user on our platform, you will be asked to connect you wallet when you land of our page and then you can either joins the live streams, or create your own stream using livepeer. if you join someone else's stream you can trade on their streamer token or tip them directly from the chat section. if you want to start a stream, you will be asked to share the name of the token you want to deploy along with the stream, and it will be automatically deployed onchain, and yu can start getting tips in crypto directly to your connected wallet!
how_its_made: This project uses livepeer apis for smooth live streaming after the user is differentiated using his/her unique wallet address. You can directly tip your fav streamer on Base  sepolia eth. It was also locally deployed and tested on hardhat v3 ignition. We have also implemented contracts for base and hardhat deployment.
